links.comparator_used: Aggregate performance across all patients in the 2023 cohort (AUROC about 0.978 for XGBoost)
links.outcome: Subgroup discrimination (AUROC) by age group, compared with aggregate discrimination
links.effect: AUROC 0.993 in adults aged 19–64 years versus 0.930 in adults aged 65 years or older, against aggregate AUROC of 0.977–0.980 across models
links.quote: AUROC was 0.993 among adults aged 19–64 years and 0.930 among adults aged 65 years or older.

design_hint: recalibration and threshold monitoring over time
